candidate.title: Rapture
candidate.scope: The assigned poster row labelled Rapture (RAD Capture; described in the catalogue as Restriction-Site Associated DNA Capture), at schematic rather than executable-protocol scope. It combines well-barcoded, biotin-adapter RAD-fragment isolation, separate sequencing-library preparation with plate barcodes, cross-plate pooling, and capture of chosen RAD loci using biotinylated baits. The adjacent SLAF-seq, hyRAD and Digenome-seq rows and the right-hand chemical/QR artwork are context, not alternative Rapture workflows. The two named wells and two named plates are representative compartments, not sample-count requirements. The single upstream drawing is a per-plate template: separate operation instances preserve the independent well and plate preparations established by the catalogue, and the only cross-plate mixing is the drawn Pool after plate-specific library preparation. The row ends at DNA; downstream sequencing is described as the product interface, not added as a depicted operation. The catalogue page was checked visually: its heading and schematic match the assigned Rapture route. Primary-paper content available here is abstract-only; the detailed depicted route is supported by the image and the matching secondary catalogue paragraph.
